newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-GANGULY AND DHARMANI FINED 25 PERCENT OF MATCH FEE.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-GANGULY AND DHARMANI FINED 25 PERCENT OF MATCH FEE.

text.p: Indian players Saurav Ganguly and Pankaj Dharmani have been fined 25 percent of their match fee following an incident in the third test against South Africa on Monday.
The two were charged by match referee Barry Jarman with bringing the game into disrepute and attempting to intimidate an umpire on the final morning of the drawn match.
Both players appeared at a disciplinary meeting with Jarman who said they had "...charged at umpire Peter Willey" after a bat-pad appeal against Adam Bacher was turned down.
Jarman announced his decision after viewing video evidence on Tuesday.
*South African all-rounder Brian McMillan has been ruled out of the triangular one-day series with India and Zimbabwe because of injury.
McMillan has an inflamed tendon at the back of his left ankle and has been advised to rest by a specialist. He aggravated the problem during the final test against India.
McMillan is replaced in the 14-man squad by Western Province medium pacer Craig Matthews.
The tournament begins on Thursday with South Africa playing India in Bloemfontein.
